scope: All 12 ViZDoom and both tile-platformer hard examples in the frozen 146-labelled-decision/189-request coverage pass, plus the flagged customer severity example. This is a bounded post-hoc audit, not a review of all other labels or a new benchmark.

review_selection.expanded_source_slice: Every ViZDoom case (four Choice, four Noul, four Score) and both platformer cases, including provider-correct cases.
review_selection.customer: One originally flagged case with separate peer review; excluded only in the additional seven-row sensitivity.

equivalent_actions_one_hot_reference.finding: Both reviewed platformer states are airborne. Their disclosed physics ignores another jump request; right_run and right_run_jump produce identical position, reward and terminal status. Gold is a one-hot BFS enumeration preference, not a unique task action.
equivalent_actions_one_hot_reference.interpretation: An exact-reference mismatch here is not evidence of an inferior game transition.
equivalent_actions_one_hot_reference.future_version_only: Accept equivalent/optimal action sets, or explicitly state a canonical tie rule before evaluating every provider.

missing_visible_policy_parameters.finding: The named momentum-aware tracking policy has no formula, fixed eight-tic projection horizon, ten-unit deadband or sign convention in the supplied request. Source code reproduces the gold, but differently parameterized momentum-aware policies also fit the prompt.
missing_visible_policy_parameters.interpretation: Apply this flag to all four movement Choice requests, including correctly guessed ones. Keep attack and alignment questions with explicit thresholds.
missing_visible_policy_parameters.future_version_only: Publish the exact policy in a new request/data version and re-evaluate all providers; do not mutate frozen labels.

visible_rule_supports_gold.finding: The Noul attack condition or Score criteria explicitly state the numerical rules needed to derive these eight gold labels under the declared visible-target convention.
visible_rule_supports_gold.interpretation: Retain all eight; absent movement-policy parameters do not affect these separate questions.

semantic_rubric_ambiguity_needs_adjudica.finding: Account-category metadata forces severity zero, while the visible access-restoration wording can imply functional loss. The no-malfunction fallback does not explicitly equate account recovery with no functional impact. Score two also lacks evidence that no workaround exists.
semantic_rubric_ambiguity_needs_adjudica.interpretation: Zero matches generator intent but is not semantically unique. Do not automatically change gold to two or describe this as a clear reasoning failure.
semantic_rubric_ambiguity_needs_adjudica.future_version_only: State the actual functional impact and workaround availability explicitly, then version any replacement task.

technical_exclusion_rule: Within the complete affected source slice, exclude every movement Choice missing the named tracking-policy parameters and every platformer state with a proven gold-equivalent alternative action. Do not choose exclusions according to provider correctness.
sensitivity_interpretation: Both post-hoc sensitivities apply identical request-ID exclusions to all three completed provider coverage reports and preserve their scoring and validation policies. These are supplementary narrower analyses; neither replaces the primary score nor establishes accuracy on a corrected benchmark. No revised gold, redistributed targets, rerun, uncertainty estimate or population claim is made.

state.objective: Reach the flag without falling into a gap.
state.physics: Original discrete tile simulator; no emulator, enemies, momentum or sprites. Full terrain is visible.

decision.instructions: Choose a controller macro to reach the right-hand flag without falling into a gap. Walking moves one tile; running moves two. A jump from the ground follows the four-tick heights 2, 3, 2, 0 above its starting height; airborne jump requests do not restart it. Solid columns block horizontal movement below their top. Read the terrain and trajectory.
Which lateral movement does the momentum-aware tracking policy choose to align with the nearest visible target?

evidence.source_movement_rule: left if error > 10.0; right if error < -10.0; otherwise hold

decision.instructions: How severe is the reported issue? Use the stated functional impact and the existence of a workaround. Use no functional impact when no malfunction is described. In this synthetic control, if a broken feature is described but the availability of a workaround is explicitly unknown, the two latent possibilities (workaround exists; no workaround exists) are equally likely.
criteria: Cosmetic; no impact to functionality
Broken or degraded feature; workaround exists
Blocking issue; no workaround exists

evidence.visible_issue: I need access restored after changing the email address used to sign in.
evidence.visible_fallback: Use no functional impact when no malfunction is described.
evidence.generator_rule: No latent bug_report category => severity zero, apart from explicit generated severity ambiguity.

independent_peer_review.method: Read only final state, rubric and source generator; no model reasoning, API calls or edits.
independent_peer_review.conclusion: Zero fits generator intent, but access restoration can imply functional impact. Two lacks no-workaround evidence. Preserve original score and flag for adjudication.

decision.instructions: Rate the current shot alignment using the supplied ordered suitability grades. These grades are an aiming heuristic, not expected game reward.
criteria: Cannot usefully aim a shot: no live visible target, no ammunition, dead player, or absolute target bearing above 22 degrees.
Very poor alignment: live visible target and ammunition, player alive, absolute target bearing above 12 and at most 22 degrees.
Coarse alignment: live visible target and ammunition, player alive, absolute target bearing above 6 and at most 12 degrees.
Near alignment: live visible target and ammunition, player alive, absolute target bearing above 3 and at most 6 degrees.
Aligned for the script's shot: live visible target and ammunition, player alive, absolute target bearing at most 3 degrees.

evidence.visible_rule: Visible ordered criteria use angle boundaries 3, 6, 12 and 22 degrees, plus target/ammo/player-alive conditions.
